Rubik's cube · beginner

Print version (PDF) ⤓ · next: CFOP sheet ›
Hold: step 1 white on top → steps 2-6 yellow on top → step 7 yellow on the bottom · green in front throughout
sexy R U R' U'left sexy L' U' L Uright hand / left hand, again and again: most of the solve

1 · White crossWhite on top · edges only; side colours match their centres

  1. Find a white edge on the bottom layer (two colours, not a corner).
  2. Turn the bottom until the edge sits under the centre of its other colour, then turn that face twice.
  3. Edge in the middle layer: turn that side once to drop it to the bottom, turn the bottom to move it away, then turn that side back so your cross is fixed again. Then as above.
  4. Check: a white cross on top, and each edge's side colour matches the centre below it.
Edge on the bottom
Green sticker on the bottom row, white hidden underneath; turn the bottom until green is under the green centre
D' · F2
bottom until it matches · face twice
Edge on top, flipped
White edge in the top front, white facing you
F U' R U
F out to the side · top back · R up · top again

2 · White cornersTurn it upside down: white on the bottom, same face towards you · corner above its slot, then sexy until it drops in

  1. Find a top corner with white. Its other two colours say where it goes: turn the top until it sits right above that spot.
  2. Corner going to the right: sexy, again and again until it drops in. Going to the left: left sexy. Never more than 5 times.
  3. Corner stuck in the bottom, wrong way round: do sexy once to bring it up, then as above.
Right side
Corner above its slot at the front-right (here white faces right)
R U R' U'
sexy again and again until it drops in: 1 time here (white up: 3, white facing you: 5)
Left side
Corner above its slot at the front-left (here white faces left)
L' U' L U
left sexy again and again until it drops in: 1 time here (white up: 3, white facing you: 5)

3 · Middle layerYellow on top · top edge with no yellow; match its front colour to the centre

  1. Turn the top until the edge's front colour matches the centre below it. Its top colour says left or right.
  2. Going right: top away to the left (U), sexy. Turn the whole cube so the right side faces you (y), left sexy, turn it back. Going left: the mirror.
  3. Edge already in its spot but the wrong way round: put any top edge into that spot (same moves as below). That pops the stuck edge up to the top; then match it and insert it as usual.
Edge goes right
Front colour matches the centre; top colour is the right centre
U · R U R' U' · y · L' U' L U · y'
U away · sexy · turn the cube (right side to you) · left sexy · turn back
Edge goes left
Front colour matches the centre; top colour is the left centre
U' · L' U' L U · y' · R U R' U' · y
U' away · left sexy · turn the cube (left side to you) · sexy · turn back
Edge in its spot, flipped
Front-right edge in place but its colours are swapped
R U R' U' · y · L' U' L U · y'
pop it out (sexy · turn · left sexy · turn back), then U to match it and "Edge goes right"

4 · Yellow crossYellow on top · edges only; corners ignored (grey)

  1. F · sexy · F' each time. Dot gives an L; L (held at the back-left) gives a line; line (held left to right) gives the cross.
Dot
No yellow edges up
F R U R' U' F'
you get an L: turn the top to put it at the back-left, next card
L
L at the back and the left
F R U R' U' F'
you get a line: next card
Line
Line left to right
F R U R' U' F'
you get the yellow cross

5 · Yellow edgesYellow on top · side colours of the yellow edges

  1. Turn the top to line up as many edge colours as you can. All four: done.
  2. Two next to each other: hold them at the back and the right, do the algorithm, line up.
  3. Two opposite: do it once from anywhere, line up, then you have the case above.
Two next to each other
Matched edges at the back and the right
R U R' U R U2 R' · U
then turn the top to line them all up

6 · Yellow corners in placeYellow on top · right spot only; twisted is fine for now

  1. A corner is in the right spot when its three colours match the three centres around it.
  2. Hold the one right corner at the front-right and do the algorithm (once or twice). None right: do it once from anywhere first.
One corner right
The right corner at the front-right
U R U' L' U R' U' L
keep that corner at the front-right; repeat if needed

7 · Twist the cornersTurn it upside down: yellow on the bottom, same face towards you · one corner at a time, at the bottom front-right

  1. Sexy again and again until that corner shows yellow on the bottom (2 or 4 times). The rest looks broken: keep going.
  2. Turn only the bottom layer (D) to bring the next twisted corner to the front-right. Never turn the whole cube.
  3. When all four are done, turn the bottom to line it up. Solved!
Two corners to twist
Yellow on the bottom; twisted corner at the bottom front-right
